name: Mini-LLM
description: A ground-up LLM engineering project: tokenizer → architecture → training → scaling laws → inference. Starts at 80M, engineered to scale into 1B+ models with minimal changes. Clean, research-ready code for anyone serious about understanding and building LLMs from first principles.

paragraphs: A production-grade implementation of a decoder-only transformer language model, built from scratch with modern best practices. This project demonstrates the complete pipeline from raw text to a functioning LLM capable of text generation.
There are many "build your own GPT" tutorials out there. So why Mini-LLM?
features: RoPE (Rotary Position Embeddings): Better extrapolation to longer sequences than learned positions
RMSNorm: Faster and simpler than LayerNorm, used in LLaMA
SwiGLU: Gated activation function, empirically better than GELU/ReLU
Grouped Query Attention: Reduces KV cache size for faster inference
Memory-Mapped Data Loading: Train on TB-scale datasets with minimal RAM
